Topic 3.1: Cleaning waste disposal facilities (Waste bin, sink and open drains.)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cleaning waste disposal facilities (Waste bin, sink and open drains.), part of HYGIENE PRACTICES in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How do cleaning waste disposal facilities promote hygiene? 2. Why do we clean waste disposal facilities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign words related to cleaning waste disposal facilities,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cleaning waste disposal facilities (Waste bin, sink and open drains.) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

Values:
● Responsibility: as the learner takes initiative to maintain cleanliness.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Environmental awareness and protection: As the learner analyses and design ways of cleaning waste facilities.

● Hygiene: As the learner maintains cleanliness of waste facilities.
